name: com.liminallabs.atlas
description: Knowing where things are. Register an object once and it appears on the compass bar at the correct bearing, as an on-screen indicator, on the minimap and on the world map - from one solve, so the views cannot disagree about what is behind you. Maps are planes with world transforms rather than textures, which is what makes interiors, baking, discovery and zoom LOD the same idea with different numbers. Pure solve, replaceable presenters, no singleton, no Addressables, no inheritance in the public API. Compass letters and distance labels need a one-time Window > TextMeshPro > Import TMP Essential Resources; everything else works without it. Namespace LiminalLabs.Atlas.

samples.description: The milestone: one registration per marker, on the compass bar AND as an on-screen indicator, including behind you. Three entry points, and Tab shows the raw solve behind the pixels. Import, then Window > Liminal Labs > Atlas > Build M0 Sample Scene.

The map milestone: a minimap that follows and turns, and a world map that does neither - the same projection with two framings, fed by the same registrations as the compass and the on-screen indicators. WASD, right mouse to look, M for the world map. Import, then Window > Liminal Labs > Atlas > Build M1 Sample Scene.
